text: REJECT: `ShipAsync` returns `ship.MainMoved` as `Requeued` even when `ship.Unjudged` is also set, whereas the original only set `requeued` in the `else if` branch, so the unjudged case took precedence. If both are ever set, the refactor also parks the merged packages as requeued and records `Requeued` in the turn record, which changes behaviour; it should return `ship.Unjudged is null ? ship.MainMoved : null`.
